mapping.draft_py:
# Brought Back: "Choose up to two target permanent cards in your graveyard that were put there from
# the battlefield this turn. Return them to the battlefield tapped." One MOVE_ZONE whose cards are
# the targets: Sanguine Indulgence's "up to two target ... cards from your graveyard" (QAtMost(2)
# TARGET over Zone(GRAVEYARD, YOU)) with Fungal Rebirth's "permanent card" (IS_PERMANENT) and
# Barrin's "put into your <zone> from the battlefield this turn" (MOVED_TO_ZONE_THIS_TURN, per card);
# "Return them to the battlefield" is Rise Again's destination and "tapped" the tapped_on_enter role.
# The compiler gave no tree at all; the instant carrier is added.
abilities = [
    SpellAbility(
        kind=SpellKind.INSTANT,
        effect=A(Verb.MOVE_ZONE, {
            'cards': Selector(
                count=QAtMost(n=2),
                mode=SelectorMode.TARGET,
                filter=FAnd(children=(
                    FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_PERMANENT),
                    FAtom(
                        pred=FAtomPred.MOVED_TO_ZONE_THIS_TURN,
                        who=ControllerRef.YOU,
                        from_zone=Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),
                        to_zone=Zone(kind=ZoneKind.GRAVEYARD, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),
                    ),
                )),
                zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.GRAVEYARD, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),),
            ),
            'destination': Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),
            'tapped_on_enter': True,
        }),
    ),
]

mapping.notes: The compiler built no tree; the instant carrier is added. The probe board has no card put into a graveyard this turn (0..0 targets).
